name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Hörfinghof
beschreibung: The Hörfinghof in Kufstein is a farm with holiday apartments. The accommodations have a bathroom and a kitchen. The farm is located in the municipal area of Kufstein, from where the city center and the fortress can be reached quickly. Agricultural products are produced on the farm. The surroundings of Kufstein are rich in hiking and cycling trails. The nearby Kaisergebirge invites excursions. Kufstein is a transport hub with good rail connections.
